glosses: Tamil; taal die gesproken wordt in India, Sri Lanka, Singapore, en Maleisië
Of or pertaining to the Tamil people, culture, or language.

examples.text: When I returned to the movie Ghilli, a Kollywood classic (Kollywood being the informal name for Tamil cinema) that I loved as a kid, I couldn’t help but question why the story continues romantically, without question, after the heroine is slapped by the supposed love of her life.

glosses: A Dravidian language spoken in the state of Tamil Nadu, India and in Sri Lanka, Singapore, Malaysia.

examples.text: “I go only to return,” I said, because Tamil has no words for last goodbyes.

glosses: A person who originates from Tamil Nadu, India or Sri Lanka or has tamil origins.
